item.title: 4-year-old hit by driver in Henrico apartment complex
item.description: A 4-year-old boy was struck by a driver in an apartment complex in eastern Henrico Friday afternoon, according to police.

item.title: Djokovic scores 16 as VCU downs Dayton 68-62
item.description: Lazar Djokovic scored 16 points as VCU beat Dayton 68-62 on Friday night to snap the Flyers' six-game win streak.

item.title: 2 arrests made in deadly Shockoe Bottom mass shooting, Crime Insider sources tell Jon Burkett
item.description: Two arrests have been made in connection to a deadly mass shooting in Richmond's Shockoe Bottom neighborhood last month, Crime Insider sources tell Jon Burkett.
